pins.definition: Unhappy because of having no friends or company.
feeling sad because you are alone and have no one to talk to
Unhappy because one has no friends or company.

situation: An elderly man sits alone at a large dining table set for four in a quiet apartment at dusk.
subject: the sadness of being alone
brief: An old man sits slumped at the head of a long wooden dining table, his shoulders curved inward while three empty chairs remain pushed out with untouched places laid before them. The dim evening light falls across his bowed head and the vast, empty space between the plates, emphasizing the absolute silence of the room.
